step1.title: Learning Preferences
step1.subtitle: Personalize your KaushalAI experience. Configure your preferred language, color theme, and appearance mode before proceeding.
step1.settings_notice: You can modify these preferences anytime later in Settings.

step2.heading: What areas of work interest you?
step2.description: Select the professional domains you are interested in. Your selections will help us personalize your learning experience.
step2.min_requirement_notice: Select at least 1 domain to continue
step2.ready_notice: Ready to proceed. You can select additional domains if desired.

survey_operations.name: Data Collection & Survey Operations
survey_operations.desc: National sampling frames, household & enterprise field surveys, CAPI digital instruments, and multi-stage sampling.

statistical_analysis.name: Statistical Analysis & Modeling
statistical_analysis.desc: Descriptive and inferential statistics, sampling error estimation, hypothesis testing, and regression analysis for official data.

data_processing.name: Data Processing & Management
data_processing.desc: Enterprise database structures, SQL query pipelines, administrative big data registers, and scalable ETL processing.

data_quality.name: Data Quality & Validation
data_quality.desc: Multi-stage field data scrutiny, high-frequency validation checks, statistical auditing, and data quality frameworks.

data_visualization.name: Data Visualization & Reporting
data_visualization.desc: Interactive analytical dashboards, thematic statistical charting, GIS spatial mapping, and publication infographics.

research_methodology.name: Research & Methodology
research_methodology.desc: Questionnaire formulation, stratification strategies, small area estimation, and survey design research methodologies.

national_accounts.name: National Accounts & Macroeconomics
national_accounts.desc: Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Gross Value Added (GVA), supply-use tables, capital formation, and institutional sector accounts.

price_indices.name: Price Indices & Economic Indicators
price_indices.desc: Consumer Price Index (CPI), Index of Industrial Production (IIP), wholesale price deflators, and inflation tracking.

official_policy.name: Official Statistics & Policy
official_policy.desc: Government statistical governance, public data policies, confidentiality protocols, and evidence-based decision making.

digital_tools.name: Digital Tools & Technology
digital_tools.desc: Statistical computing in Python and R, machine learning algorithms, automated data scrutiny, and cybersecurity governance.

data_dissemination.name: Data Dissemination & SDG Tracking
data_dissemination.desc: Public data release portals, microdata anonymization, National Indicator Framework (NIF), and UN SDG monitoring.

administration_coordination.name: Administration & Coordination
administration_coordination.desc: Field office coordination, project management, resource allocation, and inter-divisional statistical workflows.
